shortDescription: Monte dei Paschi di Siena MIL:BMPS on Saturday released its official opinion on the €34.5 billion ($38 billion) buyout offer by Intesa Sanpaolo MILSEDEX:I05811, ahead of the start of the tender phase on Tuesday.• The sweetened price is fair as of November 18, based on the opinions of the bank's fin…

children: on Saturday released its official opinion on the €34.5 billion ($38 billion) buyout offer by Intesa Sanpaolo
, ahead of the start of the tender phase on Tuesday.
• The sweetened price is fair as of November 18, based on the opinions of the bank's financial advisers, MPS said
• However, Intesa's offer does not capture in full the value MPS is set to generate thanks to its successful acquisition of Mediobanca, it said
• An MPS director, veteran banker Corrado Passera, quit his board seat late on Friday citing disagreements over the bid
• The board of MPS unanimously approved the position
• The final view represents a compromise between the positions of two opposing factions on the board, a person with knowledge of the matter said
• MPS said that its investors stood to receive too small a portion of the benefits Intesa expects to reap from the deal
MPS shareholders can tender their shares under Intesa's bid from Tuesday
MPS board met on Friday for official assessment of the bid
Board reached unanimous position but one director resigned
